# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 19 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 19 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_019_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 19

**19:1** And they stood at the entrance to the cave, and behold, a luminous cloud overshadowed the cave. And the midwife said, "My soul is magnified today, because my eyes have seen wonderful things; for salvation has been born to Israel." And immediately the cloud withdrew from the cave, and a great light appeared in the cave so that their eyes could not bear it. And a little while afterward, the light withdrew until the infant appeared. And it went and took the breast of its mother Mary.

**19:2** And the midwife cried out, saying, "Great for me is this day, in that I have seen this new sight."

**19:3** And the midwife came out from the cave, and Salome met her. And the midwife said to her, "Salome, Salome, I have a new sight to tell you about. A virgin has brought forth, which her nature does not allow."

**19:4** And Salome said, "As the Lord my God lives, unless I insert my finger and examine her condition, I will not believe that a virgin has brought forth."

**19:5** And the midwife went in and said to Mary, "Brace yourself, for no small controversy has arisen concerning you." And Salome inserted her finger to examine her condition. And she cried out, saying, "Woe for my iniquity and my unbelief, because I have tempted the living God, and behold, my hand is falling away from me in fire!"

**19:6** And Salome bent her knees before the Lord, saying, "O God of my fathers, remember me, for I am the seed of Abraham and Isaac and Jacob. Do not make me an example before the children of Israel, but restore me to the poor; for you know, O Lord, that in your name I have performed my services, and have received my wage from you."

**19:7** And behold, an angel of the Lord stood before her, saying to her, "Salome, Salome, the Lord God has heard your prayer. Bring your hand to the infant and carry him, and you will have salvation and joy."

**19:8** And Salome came near and took him up, saying, "I will worship him, because he is born a king to Israel." And immediately Salome was healed, and she came out from the cave justified, glorifying and praising God. And behold, a voice saying, "Salome, Salome, tell not what marvels you have seen until the child has come to Jerusalem."
